title: The Line That Made Him Rich
description:
Marlo stood in line for three hours. Then a stranger offered him $20 for his spot, and everything changed.

Watch how a boring wait turned into a million-dollar idea, the disaster that almost ended it, and how he beat an app that skips every line.

New Marble Street story every day. Subscribe so you don't miss the next business.

Marble Street is an animated series about creative business ideas. Marlo, his street and every event are fictional. Made with AI tools (animation and voice).
